thread:
Maria C (Partnerships): Quick sync request — attempting to get our cloud catalog artifacts and legal packaging ready for AWS / GCP / Azure pushes. Need checklist alignment: agreements, logos, AMIs/container digests, SKU mapping, pricing buckets. Who can take which pieces?

Jeff K (Legal): I can own the legal checklist. Need publisher agreement version (is it v3?), EULA draft, and confirmation on indemnity / data processing addendum. Also will need SOC2 contact and marketing logo approval process.

Sanjeev (Product): SKU mapping is on my side. Propose three SKUs: starter / scale / enterprise. Starter = limited tokens + no SLA, Scale = paid tokens + 99.9% latency SLO, Enterprise = reserved capacity (dedicated) w/ SLA. We need to decide metering: hosted = per-token, dedicated = per-hour. Also do we include a free trial SKU?

Olivia R (Eng): Artifacts list: for AWS we need AMI IDs + launch template, for GCP list of image digests (gcr), for Azure the managed image URN. Also container images + digest file, helm chart + values file for private deployments. Add `listing.json` metadata (pricing, support contact, region availability). I can produce a small manifest generator.

Olivia R (Eng): Code snippet for manifest generator:```bash
# generate listing manifest
./scripts/generate_manifest.sh --provider aws,gcp,azure --out listing.json
```

Publish-Bot: Checklist updated — artifacts_uploaded: false -> true (manual flag set by Olivia). :white_check_mark:

Jeff K (Legal): For agreements: yes use publisher-agreement v3. I will attach a redlined EULA by tomorrow. We also need a short trademark usage blurb for logos and a contact for privacy/KMS arrangements. Please send drafts to jeff.k@redwood.com.

Sanjeev (Product): I'll own SKU CSV and pricing tiers. Quick question: do we support BYOC (bring-your-own-cost) for customer-managed infra in the catalog, or just offer our managed listing?

Maria C (Partnerships): We should offer both: list a managed offering and a BYOC option in the catalog with separate SKUs. Partners care about choice.

Olivia R (Eng): I'll upload AMI IDs + container digests to the partner bucket and add `image-digests.txt` to the manifest. Also will include sample `values.yaml` for helm and note default resource limits. Will ping when uploads complete.

Maria C (Partnerships): Timeline: aim to submit publishers portal by EOD Friday. Dependencies: Jeff signoff on EULA, Olivia uploads artifacts, Sanjeev finalizes SKU/pricing. Can everyone confirm?

Jeff K (Legal): Confirmed — legal will triage by Thu COB.

Sanjeev (Product): Confirmed — I'll drop the SKU CSV and mapping doc in the /partnerships drive today.

Olivia R (Eng): Confirmed — uploading artifacts now, will share links in this thread when done.

Maria C (Partnerships): Awesome. I'll create the partner portal PR and loop in cloud account reps for AWS/GCP/Azure listing contacts. Ping me if blockers pop up. :rocket:

Sanjeev (Product): One last note — pricing display needs to include both per-token and per-hour lines for the listing UI. We should submit sample pricing strings to marketing.

Jeff K (Legal): Added marketing and privacy checklist items to the legal doc.

Publish-Bot: Submission checklist: agreements: pending, artifacts: uploaded, sku_csv: pending, pricing_examples: pending.

Maria C (Partnerships): Thanks team — will follow up with a short action doc and owners. @Sanjeev @Olivia R (Eng) @Jeff K (Legal) — added to the PR.

Olivia R (Eng): uploaded: s3://partners/redwood/cloud-artifacts/1792105432/ — manifest + digests. Sharing in PR. :thumbsup:
